script.spokenHook: Aerodrome jumped 20% today, but RSI is already flashing overbought.
script.hook: Aerodrome Pulls Off A Surprise Rally
segmentLines: AERO gained over 20% to reach about $0.85, rebounding from its 24-hour low of $0.68.
Price is sitting near the four-hour high of $0.86, pushing its RSI up to 77.
Trading volume topped $121 million today, representing over 14% of its entire market cap.
script.takeaway: Trading near highs with RSI in overbought territory
script.cta: Can Aerodrome hold this rally or is a pullback coming? Share your thoughts below and subscribe.
